reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 13.1 is an expiry-based term (running until the Secondary Royalty Term expires on a Product/country basis) with no evergreen or automatic renewal mechanic, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price uplift, so none of the risks RENEWAL targets are present.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

The failing deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days — number not found') is consistent with the absence of any renewal notice mechanic rather than evidence of a deviation, so it does not undercut the classification.

Supporting terms cited (perpetual, fully paid-up royalty-free licence on expiry under 13.1 and Ono's unilateral without-cause termination right under 13.2) favour our side (Ono, the licensee), correctly avoiding an over-flag.
